correctness.rationale: Kummer/Legendre digit identity gives the exact carry budget 3. All accepted histories terminate by the third zero column above the highest set bit; hence exact density equals an integer-state count over a finite residue modulus. Three intervening zero columns similarly eliminate carry across any longer gap; thus clipping gaps to four is proved for all positive gaps, not inferred from experiments. Sixteen rational state counts reproduced by independent stopped-measure recurrence and by direct residue enumeration, plus 256 diagnostic larger-gap comparisons. The finite table exhausts all shifts by proof, yielding sharp and unique gap minimizers.

value.rationale: Cheng’s 2026 fixed-Hamming-weight program defines the natural extremal invariant \(F(k)\) but reports its asymptotic behavior at large weight. This theorem determines \(F(3)=3/32\), every attainable density at weight three, and precisely the two odd minimizers up to powers of two. The carry-budget gap barrier reduces unbounded gap families to finitely many certifiable cases. It is a complete motivated natural stratum rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
